description.fun: Gastly is 95% poisonous gas, which makes it one of the lightest Pokémon there is, and it gives off a faint, sweet smell. Its gas can wrap around an enemy of any size and knock it out. Strong winds make it dwindle away, so groups of Gastly huddle together under the eaves of houses to shelter from the breeze.
description.guide: A Ghost and Poison Pokémon made almost entirely of poisonous gas, appearing as a dark sphere wrapped in a purple haze. It haunts old buildings and comes out at night, and strong winds can blow it away. It evolves into Haunter and then Gengar.
description.tagline: A sweet-smelling puff of poison gas with a grin

description.fun: Haunter fears the light, so it hides in dark places and slips through walls. If anyone comes near, it floats after them, beckoning them closer, then licks them with its gassy tongue, which sends them into convulsions. Its Japanese name is simply Ghost, the same word the Japanese games use for the Ghost type.
description.guide: The middle stage of Gastly's line, a gaseous Ghost and Poison Pokémon with a spiky head and two disembodied, floating hands. It hides in darkness, can pass through walls and attacks with a long tongue. It evolves into Gengar when traded or with a Linking Cord.
description.tagline: A floating grin with free-floating hands and a dangerous lick

description.fun: Gengar hides perfectly in shadows and loves playing tricks: one favourite is posing as someone's shadow on a full-moon night, then moving on its own and delighting in their fright. Its body soaks up heat, so the air turns about 5°C colder when it's near. Some Pokédex entries even claim it was once a human. Treat it well, though, and it can be a loyal partner.
description.guide: The final stage of Gastly's line, a dark purple Ghost and Poison Pokémon with a wide grin, red eyes and a spiky back. It hides in shadows, lowers the temperature around it and enjoys playing pranks and casting curses. It evolves from Haunter when traded, can Mega Evolve into Mega Gengar and has a Gigantamax form.
description.tagline: A grinning shadow that chills the room

description.fun: Half its body sinks into the ground, and a third, unblinking eye opens on its forehead to see into other dimensions. It lurks in another dimension waiting to strike, and is vicious enough to curse even its own Trainer.

Becomes a giant head sunk into the ground with a mouth like a tunnel, rumoured to lead not into its body but to the afterlife. Anyone standing near it may hear the voices of loved ones calling out to them.
